newWitnesses.title: Reasoning with o1

Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

newWitnesses.title: Getting Started with Mistral

Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.title: Intro to Federated Learning
topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): First federated-learning course teaches distributed training, central/local differential privacy and communication tradeoffs. Python familiarity; consult the provider for further prerequisites. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.title: Introduction to on-device AI
topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): On-device labs cover conversion, hardware acceleration, accuracy tests and quantization. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.title: Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs with Private Data
topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Distinct second federated-learning course covers private-data LLM fine-tuning, training-data leakage, PEFT and differential privacy. Relevant privacy-engineering elective; federated processing does not by itself prove confidentiality or compliance. Uses corrected course-specific URL. Python familiarity; consult the provider for further prerequisites. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Production ML lifecycle covers baselines, data definition, concept drift, error analysis, monitoring and scoping with labs/final project. Transferable evaluation foundation; not agent-specific oversight, cross-practitioner aggregation or autonomy approval. Check the provider audience/prerequisites before assigning this course. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.title: Fine-tuning & RL for LLMs: Intro to Post-training

Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Nontechnical introduction combines generative-AI capabilities/limits, prompting exercises and business impacts. Foundation/leadership orientation; corporate data rules, cyber threats and operating authorisation require internal content. No technical background required. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Four modules and automatic-code-review assignments cover agent memory, tools, guardrails, hooks, collaboration, communication, flows, observability and CI/CD. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Streamlit/Snowflake modules scope an MVP, build chatbot/RAG prototypes, gather feedback and iterate. Check the provider audience/prerequisites before assigning this course. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.

topAdditions.limitations: V10 (2026-10-18): Weights & Biases labs log experiments, version data/models and trace LLM prompts/responses. Useful evaluation observability; no integrity-protected audit trail, kill switches or bank assurance process. Python familiarity; consult the provider for further prerequisites. Assessment is of advertised teaching, not course completion or workplace authorisation.
